_source: Suspensions follow each competition's real rules (Carlos, Oct 9). Checked Oct 9: Premier League (5 yellows by match 19 = 1 match, 10 by match 32 = 2, 15 = 3; red-card bans cover all domestic competitions), English League Cup (2 yellows = 1 match, wiped at the quarter-finals), Spain (every 5 yellows), Brazil league (every 3), Brazilian Cup (every 3, wiped after the early rounds), Argentina (every 5 per tournament, wiped for the playoffs and each new tournament), UEFA 2026/27 (4 yellows, then 6, 8, 10; wiped after the quarter-finals; reds carry between European cups), CONMEBOL (every 3, wiped after the group stage). NOT YET CONFIRMED (PROPOSAL): English Cup, Spanish Cup, Argentine Cup, North American Champions Cup, English second division deadlines. Yellows are wiped at the end of each season; bans carry over. Scopes: competition = only that competition; domestic = every competition of that country; confederation = every continental cup of that confederation.

redCards._note: Second yellow = 1 match. Straight reds: professional foul 1 match (55%), dissent 2 (10%), violent conduct / serious foul play 3 (35%).
